content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP Certification in Newport News

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: Review PMI's education and project-management experience requirements for the PMP credential. Most candidates need either a bachelor's degree plus documented project-management hours, or equivalent work experience. Granite PM Academy can help you assess whether your background qualifies before you invest in training.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual PMP Boot Camp. Our instructor-led course delivers the formal education PMI requires, covering project-management frameworks, risk, procurement, and stakeholder engagement. Classes fit working professionals' schedules, so you earn your contact hours without leaving the Peninsula.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After training, submit your official PMP application to PMI and pay the exam fee. Granite PM Academy guides you through the application portal, ensuring your education and work experience are documented correctly. PMI reviews and approves your eligibility before you schedule your test.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and instructor office hours—to build confidence. On exam day, you'll take the computer-based PMP test at a Pearson VUE center. Our support helps you tackle the exam's breadth and complexity.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your Credential
steps_items.text: After earning your PMP, you'll enter PMI's standard three-year renewal cycle. Earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through training, volunteering, or professional involvement. Granite PM Academy offers ongoing learning options to help you stay current and renew without gaps.
